scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names hackathon,jwt,scraper,gateway,client,mail,etl "npm run dev:hackathon" "npm run dev:jwt" "npm run dev:scraper" "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:mail" "npm run dev:etl"
scripts.install:python: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing services/mail-service/.venv && uv pip install --python services/mail-service/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -r services/mail-service/requirements.txt && uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing ETL/.venv && uv pip install --python ETL/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -r ETL/requirements.txt
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix services/hackathon-service && npm install --prefix jwt-service && npm install --prefix scraper && npm install --prefix gateway
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix services/hackathon-service && npm run typecheck --prefix jwt-service && npm run typecheck --prefix gateway
scripts.test: npm test --prefix services/hackathon-service && npm test --prefix jwt-service && npm test --prefix gateway
